name: single_flop_sync
why: the synchronizer has one flop, so every decision happens one cycle early

name: center_sample_only
why: each bit is the centre sample alone; one corrupted centre vote flips the bit

name: msb_first
why: data bits are assembled MSB first, so every byte arrives bit-reversed

name: stop_bit_ignored
why: a low stop bit still delivers the byte and never reports a framing error

name: no_false_start_reject
why: a short low glitch starts a frame that delivers a spurious 0xFF byte

name: samples_one_tick_late
why: the three votes sit one oversample tick late (8D, 9D, 10D)

name: divider_ignored
why: hard-codes the default of 2 clk cycles per oversample tick

name: fifo_full_rejects_simultaneous_pop
why: a full FIFO drops a byte written at the same edge as a pop and reports overflow

name: frame_error_counter_wraps
why: the framing-error counter wraps from 15 to 0 instead of saturating

name: top_overflow_counter_miswired
why: the integration counts framing errors as overflows
